shrnuti: Families and travellers are queuing to cross from Russia into Estonia before all five road border crossings are shut on 1 December. The decision follows an alleged Russian-backed sabotage attempt, but has also raised concerns among people with relatives on both sides of the border.

Families and travellers are queuing to cross from Russia into Estonia before all five road border crossings are shut on 1 December. The decision follows an alleged Russian-backed sabotage attempt, but has also raised concerns among people with relatives on both sides of the border.
People carrying suitcases, backpacks and plastic bags have been gathering in the Russian border town of Ivangorod, hoping to cross into Estonia before the Baltic country closes its land border with Russia next month.
ADVERTISEMENT
ADVERTISEMENT
The queues reflect the impact of a decision that will affect not only cross-border travel but also families with relatives living on opposite sides of the frontier.
Estonia, a member of NATO and the European Union, announced on 20 November that it would suspend road crossings at all five road border checkpoints with Russia from 1 December. The restriction is due to remain in place for six months,…

Source : Defence24 , as reported by European Pravda
Details : Kosiniak-Kamysz believes Poland needs greater support from other NATO member states to effectively defend its airspace.

He said he would like to see more active involvement from Poland's partners and stressed the need to strengthen the country's intelligence systems.

titulekPuvodni: Russia planned ‘false flag’ operation with mass casualties on Polish territory, Rzeczpospolita reports
shrnuti: Russian intelligence services planned a sabotage operation on Polish territory for late October or early November, senior sources told the Polish newspaper Rzeczpospolita. The plan could have involved crossing the border and staging an attack on a target inside Poland.

vyrez.text:
Russia planned ‘false flag’ operation with mass casualties on Polish territory, Rzeczpospolita reports — Meduza
Skip to main content
Russia planned ‘false flag’ operation with mass casualties on Polish territory, Rzeczpospolita reports
November 18, 2026, 9:26 am
Source: Rzeczpospolita
Russian intelligence services planned a sabotage operation on Polish territory for late October or early November, senior sources told the Polish newspaper Rzeczpospolita. The plan could have involved crossing the border and staging an attack on a target inside Poland.
They said the sabotage could have been staged as a “false flag” operation meant to pin the blame on Kyiv.
The warning about the planned sabotage came from intelligence services in partner countries, though analysts at Polish intelligence agencies also raised the possibility of a provocation, the newspaper’s sources said. Rzeczpospolita reported that similar warnings were sent to intelligence services in the Baltic states: Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania.
“We had information about specific sites where the attack was supposed to take place. The Russians were counting on a large number of casualties,” one of the newspaper’s sources…

Pohyb ruské sabotážní skupiny Černí Rusové byl důvodem rozsáhlé operace polských bezpečnostních sil u hranic s ruskou Kaliningradskou oblastí. Uvedl to polský veřejnoprávní rozhlas Polskie Radio 24. Varšava na severovýchodě svého území zřídila speciální jednotku. Reagovala tak na varování rozvědky před možnými ruskými sabotážemi a vpády přes hranice.
Foto: Kuba Stezycki, Reuters
Polští vojáci z 18. mechanizované divize hlídají polskou hranici s Běloruskem
Článek
„V reakci na hrozbu sabotáží posílily polské bezpečnostní složky ochranu hranic,“ vysvětlila stanice přesuny na polské straně hranice s ruskou Kaliningradskou oblastí. Velení polských bezpečnostních sil vyslalo do Podlaského a Varmijsko-mazurského vojvodství posily, včetně příslušníků polské speciální jednotky GROM, dalších příslušníků pohraniční stráže a policejních protiteroristických jednotek.
Podle polského premiéra Donalda Tuska se posily aktivovaly, když pohraničníci v noci na úterý zaznamenali…

The Latvian Armed Forces have deployed a drone interceptor after an unidentified unmanned aerial vehicle breached Latvian airspace on the evening of 1 November.
Source: European Pravda , citing Latvian media outlet LSM
Details: An
orange alert
An orange alert in Latvia refers to a high-level warning issued by authorities either for airspace threats (such as detected drones or aircraft) or for severe weather conditions (such as violent thunderstorms and heavy hail)

Seventeen minutes later, the flying object exited Latvian airspace, crossing back over the Latvian-Russian border.
The Latvian military reacted to the detected threat to its airspace by launching a Blaze interceptor drone. At 19:19, the decision was taken to activate the interceptor's self-destruct mechanism to prevent any potential risk of violating the state border with Russia.

A fighter jet. Stock photo: Getty Images
Radar surveillance systems operated by Romania's Ministry of National Defence detected two unmanned aerial vehicles that had entered the country's airspace without authorisation on the evening of 31 October.
Source: Romania's Ministry of National Defence , as reported by European Pravda
Details: Romania scrambled four F-16 fighter jets and an IAR-330 SOCAT helicopter to monitor the situation and manage the response after two unmanned aerial vehicles violated the country's airspace.
Advertisement:





Alerts were issued in six Romanian counties due to the airspace violation: Iași, Neamț, Vaslui, Botoșani, Bacău and Suceava.
One of the two drones left the country's airspace, while the other was last spotted in the area between the counties of Vaslui and Bacău.
No drone crashes were reported.

NICOLAS TUCAT / AFP
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said on Saturday the EU stands in full solidarity with Denmark and strongly condemns an assassination attempt against a U.S.-Ukrainian citizen in Denmark allegedly orchestrated by Russian intelligence services.
"This was an attack on EU soil. And it is unacceptable. We stand in full solidarity with Denmark. And with all Member States targeted by Russian hybrid attacks," she said in an X post.
The Russian embassy in Copenhagen said on Friday the accusations were not backed with proof.
Von der Leyen added that EU will soon propose a "new European Security Strategy" to reinforce preparedness and deterrence.

Source : Estonian public broadcaster ERR , as reported by European Pravda
Details : At 04:42, the Estonian Armed Forces reported a possible drone threat in the two counties. The military also stated that aircraft from NATO allies, including Turkish fighter jets, were in the air.

Zdroj: Vojenské správa Dněpropetrovské oblasti
Ruská armáda podnikla v pátek večer raketový a dronový útok na Kryvyj Rih na jihovýchodě Ukrajiny. Zemřela dvacetiletá zdravotnická záchranářka a sedmileté dítě. Zraněných je 58 lidí, včetně šesti dětí, oznámil ráno šéf městské správy Dněpropetrovské oblasti Oleksandr Vilkul. Rusové v noci udeřili také na Kyjev, Charkov či Záporoží.
„Nepřítel s nasazením balistických raket a dronů skoro desetkrát zaútočil na pět čtvrtí,“ napsal na telegramu velitel vojenské správy Dněpropetrovské oblasti Oleksandr Hanža.
Útok v Kryvém Rihu kromě lidských ztrát způsobil rozsáhlé škody: poničených je skoro 25 panelových domů, školy, restaurace, nemocnice, blíže neurčená infrastruktura, sanitky nebo auta patřící…

Pokus o atentát na Alberta Vasiljeva policie zmařila pár minut před začátkem vystoupení. Rapper byl v minulosti obviněn ruskou tajnou službou z přípravy dronového útoku na strategické objekty v Moskvě.
Článek
Dánsko vyhostí ze země ruského diplomata krátce poté, co dánská bezpečnostní a zpravodajská služba (PET) upozornila na to, že Rusko v září plánovalo atentát na ukrajinského rappera na předměstí Kodaně. Moskva na vyhoštění svého diplomata zareaguje odpovídajícími kroky, uvedla podle agentury TASS mluvčí ruského ministerstva zahraničí Marija Zacharovová.
„Jsme pevně přesvědčeni, že pokus o atentát naplánovaly ruské zpravodajské služby,“ uvedl na tiskové konferenci šéf PET Rasmus Kieffer-Kristensen. „Pokus o atentát ze strany Ruska je něco, s čím jsme se v Dánsku dosud nesetkali, a to vyvolává dojem, že Rusko je stále agresivnější a ochotnější podstupovat rizika,“…

titulekPuvodni: Russian security service detains Elena Belikova, former director of a state youth patriotism center, in embezzlement case
shrnuti: Russia’s Federal Security Service detained Elena Belikova in Moscow in a case involving the alleged embezzlement of a very large sum, two sources told the business outlet RBC. Skip to main content
Russian security service detains Elena Belikova, former director of a state youth patriotism center, in embezzlement case
November 20, 2026, 8:11 pm
Source: RBC
Russia’s Federal Security Service detained Elena Belikova in Moscow in a case involving the alleged embezzlement of a very large sum, two sources told the business outlet RBC. Belikova holds a doctorate in political science and formerly led Rospatriottsentr, a state center for patriotic education.
According to the sources, Belikova faces more than 10 years in prison on charges of embezzling government funds allocated for Rospatriottsentr projects. On November 19, a court issued a pretrial order barring her from certain activities.
Rospatriottsentr operates under Rosmolodezh, Russia’s federal youth agency, and runs programs that teach patriotism to children and young people. Among other things, the center organizes military-patriotic projects. Belikova was its director until September 2.

November 20, 2026, 5:09 pm
Source: RMF24

According to Kosiniak-Kamysz, a Kh-101 missile fell in the village of Nowy Lipowiec, another missile came down in the town of Rudnik nad Sanem, and the drone fell in Mołodycz. Air raid alerts went out in two Polish provinces bordering Ukraine as Russia attacked Ukraine overnight into November 20.
At about 6:50 a.m., residents of the Lublin and Subcarpathian provinces were warned of a possible air attack.
Jacek Goryszewski, a spokesman for the Polish Armed Forces Operational Command, said the military was investigating two possible violations of Polish airspace.

The number of people injured in Russian attacks in Zaporizhzhia's Kosmichnyi district has risen to ten.
Mykhailo Semikin, acting head of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration, said this in a Telegram post , Ukrinform reports.




"The number of people injured in the attacks on Zaporizhzhia has increased to ten," he wrote.


Apartment buildings, cars and a grocery store were damaged.






All relevant emergency and municipal services are working at the scene, the report said.

Russia’s Transportation Ministry wants to redirect airline subsidies to expand direct flights between regions as drone threats repeatedly force Moscow’s airports to suspend operations.
Transportation Minister Dmitry Yadrov said Thursday that his ministry would work with Russia’s federal aviation agency Rosaviatsia to revise how the subsidies are allocated, the Association of Tour Operators of Russia reported .
Speaking at the Transport of Russia forum, Yadrov said government subsidies support flights on 431 routes. He put the share of flights bypassing Moscow at nearly 55% and said it could rise further.
The subsidies cover more than 300 routes under a regional aviation program, about 100 routes under a program for eligible travelers and 39 routes deemed socially important in Russia’s Far East.

shrnuti: Polish military officials are examining two suspected airspace violations following a powerful blast in Lublin Voivodeship during Russia's large-scale attack on Ukraine. An unidentified object was found to have fallen near a village.

vyrez.text:
Poland investigates possible airspace breaches after explosion near Ukrainian border | Ukrainska Pravda
Aircraft. Stock photo: Getty Images
A powerful explosion was recorded in the village of Chmielek in Poland's Lublin Voivodeship on the morning of 20 November during a large-scale Russian attack on Ukraine's west. The Polish military is investigating "two possible violations" of the country's airspace and has dispatched emergency response teams to the scene.
Source: European Pravda; PAP ; RMF24 ; Polsat News ; Defence24 ; Onet
Details: CCTV footage from the vicinity of the village of Chmielek in Biłgoraj County appeared on social media on the morning of 20 November, showing a flash and capturing the sound of a loud explosion.
Advertisement:





Lieutenant Colonel Jacek Goryszewski, spokesperson for the Operational Command of the Polish Armed Forces, confirmed to Polsat News that the military is investigating "two possible violations" of Polish airspace.
He said the incidents had been recorded at approximately 06:30.

titulekPuvodni: Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv kills three and damages three Dnipro bridges, mayor says
shrnuti: Russian forces attacked Kyiv with missiles and drones overnight into November 20, targeting critical infrastructure and bridges across the Dnipro River, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.

vyrez.text:
Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv kills three and damages three Dnipro bridges, mayor says — Meduza
Skip to main content
Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv kills three and damages three Dnipro bridges, mayor says
November 20, 2026, 7:02 am
Source: Vitali Klitschko
Russian forces attacked Kyiv with missiles and drones overnight into November 20, targeting critical infrastructure and bridges across the Dnipro River, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.
Ballistic missiles damaged the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi, Darnytskyi, and Pivdennyi (Southern) bridges. Traffic on the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi Bridge has been halted, Klitschko wrote on his Telegram channel. The Pivdennyi and Darnytskyi bridges were also damaged but remain open to traffic.
Kyiv residents have been asked to avoid driving their vehicles because of “traffic delays between the left and right banks” of the Dnipro.
Russian forces also struck a facility belonging to Kyivvodokanal, the city’s water utility, during the overnight attack. Three people were killed and 15 were injured, Klitschko said. Power has been disrupted in Kyiv’s Pecherskyi, Solomianskyi, and Holosiivskyi districts, and trolleybuses are not…

titulek: Poland investigates possible airspace violation during Russian attack on Ukraine
titulekPuvodni: Poland investigates possible airspace violation during Russian attack on Ukraine
shrnuti: Military officials are verifying radar readings after sirens sounded in two eastern border regions and authorities warned residents of a potential strike

vyrez.text:
Polish air defence activated as Rzeszow airport halts flights | Ukrainska Pravda
Stock photo: Getty Images
Poland's Government Centre for Security has received information about an aerial threat following suspicions that the country's airspace has been violated by unidentified airborne objects amid a large-scale Russian attack on Ukraine on the morning of 20 November.
Source: European Pravda, citing the Operational Command of the Polish Armed Forces
Details: The command noted that reports of an airspace violation are currently being investigated in order to confirm radar system data and, if necessary, take measures to counter a potential threat.
Advertisement:





Prior to this, Poland activated the necessary air defence forces and assets amid Russian strikes on Ukraine, including on its western oblasts.
At around 06:50 on Friday 20 November, the Government Centre for Security sent alerts to residents of the Lublin and Podkarpackie voivodeships, warning them of the threat of an airstrike.
Reports also appeared on social media that air-raid sirens had sounded in the Lublin and Podkarpackie voivodeships.

shrnuti: Žhářský útok na někdejší horské útočiště Adolfa Hitlera Orlí hnízdo otevřel debatu o tom, jak by Německo mělo naložit s místem, které je spojeno s temnou nacistickou minulostí. Názory se různí – někteří chtějí na vrcholku hory ponechat ruiny, jiní mluví o přestavbě.

vyrez.text:
Přestavět shořelé Orlí hnízdo, nebo ponechat ruiny? Německo se pře o Hitlerovo dědictví — Deník N
Jedno ze sídel nacistického diktátora Adolfa Hitlera – Orlí hnízdo (Kehlsteinhaus) – vyhořelo. Foto: bavorské ministerstvo vnitra
Žhářský útok na někdejší horské útočiště Adolfa Hitlera Orlí hnízdo otevřel debatu o tom, jak by Německo mělo naložit s místem, které je spojeno s temnou nacistickou minulostí. Názory se různí – někteří chtějí na vrcholku hory ponechat ruiny, jiní mluví o přestavbě.
Více o poslechu Deníku N
Přidat Deník N mezi oblíbené zdroje
Více než osmdesát let po konci druhé světové války Němci a Němky stále hledají odpověď na palčivou otázku, jak by měli naložit se stavbami spojenými s nacismem.
Novou kapitolu v dlouholeté debatě otevřel žhářský útok na někdejší horské sídlo Adolfa Hitlera Orlí hnízdo, které se nachází poblíž Berchtesgadenu v Bavorsku. V noci z 23. na 24. října zřejmě psychicky narušený muž budovu ve výšce 1834 m n. m. zapálil. Jeho motiv zatím není znám.
Plameny objekt značně poškodily. Žár byl natolik silný, že z interiéru nezbylo téměř nic. Na fotkách, které jsou k dispozici, jsou vidět ohořelé stěny a částečně zborcená střecha.

Kyjev v noci na pátek čelil dalšímu útoku ruských balistických střel, který si podle tamních úřadů vyžádal tři mrtvé. Zsaženy byly tři mosty přes řeku Dněpr a starosta města Vitalij Klyčko už v noci informoval o požárech budov nejméně ve třech čtvrtích, včetně centra hlavního města. Podle zdrojů ruské služby BBC pak Ukrajina udeřila na ruském území, chemický závod u města Dorogobuž v ruské Smolenské oblasti čelil údajnému útoku dronů. Zprávy nelze bezprostředně nezávisle ověřit.
„Při nepřátelském útoku na hlavní město zahynuly tři osoby,“ uvedla podle agentury AFP kyjevská vojenská správa. Klyčko dodal, že dalších patnáct lidí utrpělo zranění. Starosta také oznámil, že ruské balistické rakety zasáhly tři mosty…

Tartu is allocating €33,000 for five portable power stations to help Lviv maintain essential services during widespread blackouts.
The city will purchase the units in cooperation with the Estonian Refugee Council, with the equipment intended to help Lviv keep essential services running during power outages. The funding will come from the City of Tartu's reserve fund.
As winter approaches, Tartu and the Refugee Council are working closely to get the equipment to Lviv as quickly as possible. Mayor Urmas Klaas (Reform) noted that the colder months make the power outages Ukrainians continue to face during the war even harder to endure.
"We want to help Lviv prepare for disruptions so that essential services remain available to residents even in difficult conditions," Klaas said.

A cyberattack targeting the public website of municipal transport company Tallinna Linnatransport (TLT) on Monday compromised the personal data of several thousand people, the company said.
The attack exploited a security vulnerability in software used on the website after a plugin update had not been installed. The attacker downloaded a copy of the website's database.
The incident affects 2,440 TLT employees. The leaked data included employees' names, job titles and personal identification numbers.
An initial investigation has also found that an additional 2,370 people who had submitted their information through forms on the tlt.ee website may have been affected. The exposed information may include names and email addresses entered into those forms.
